sub_indicators.label: Satellite broadband licensed and on sale
sub_indicators.subject: infra.connect
sub_indicators.text: Satellite broadband licensing and availability: satellite broadband licensed and on sale
sub_indicators.norm_short: The African Telecommunications Union's Recommendation 005-0 asks every country to license satellite broadband simply, so that users can buy it from more than one provider.
criteria: A source from the past three years says no satellite broadband provider is licensed, or that its sale or use is banned.
The regulator or ministry has licensed a provider to sell internet over satellite in the country.
Households or businesses can buy satellite broadband from a licensed provider.
Services on two different satellite networks are on sale, such as Starlink and a OneWeb or Konnect service.
The regulator publishes the number of satellite broadband subscribers, from the past three years.

aspects.name: Licensed, on sale, and from more than one network
